title: Season 2: Emberwake
summary: New weapon, a limited-time event, and the Twin Sickles head back to the workshop.

entries.text: New weapon: Hailstorm, a high fire-rate SMG.
Twin Sickles have been removed from the game while they are reworked.
Winter event: the Frost Lantern item is available for a limited time.
Respawn timer reduced so fights flow faster.
